properties.description: Built 2026-10-17 in reflow2-core's heal and inference modules (PR #763). In a line of reasoning (one side a premise or conclusion of an Inference), an opposing CONTRADICTS whose source holds and whose target reads fails is not a contradiction defect, so loop_status's structural_defects does not count it; detect_defects counts it in swept.suppressed_by_refutation (absent when zero). A contradiction whose sides hold or are unknown is still reported, and outside reasoning nothing changes.
properties.name: A standing refutation in a line of reasoning is counted as a refutation, not reported as a contradiction defect or counted as structural debt
